card.name: The word be after should
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "be" right after "should" in label instructions, such as "should be used" in pregnancy or "should be inspected" for parenteral products. It also fires on a few unrelated marked words.

modes.label: should be
modes.description: The word "be" after "should" in pregnancy or injection-handling advice.
modes.example: Parenteral drug products should<< be>> inspected visually for particulate matter and disc

modes.label: Pregnancy wording
modes.description: A small word like "be" or "to" in conditional statements about giving a drug to pregnant patients.
modes.example: if it is to be given<< to>> pregnant patients, nursing mothers, or women

modes.label: Stray parts of names and numbers
modes.description: Part of a brand name, table number or phone number.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "be" in phrases like "should be inspected" or "should be used" in drug labels.
